assets.import_path.description: The one import for any robot or asset file: USD, URDF, xacro, SDF (Gazebo), MuJoCo MJCF (.xml), a mesh prop (glTF, GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY), a ROS map (.yaml, as walls), or a folder that holds one. format=auto picks it from the name; a folder names its own entry file, or the refusal lists the candidates. Xacro and SDF are converted on the host, never by running their code. Under an approved root or a pack; source files never change. Robot formats take fixed_base and default_drives. A USD reports its drawn `visuals`; none is a warning. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

session_id.description: Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).

stage_id.description: Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.

source_path.description: Absolute path of the file, or of a folder that holds one, inside an approved root or a pack of your asset folder. Or use root_id with relative_path.

root_id.description: Approved root ID from assets__roots, with relative_path, instead of source_path.

relative_path.description: Path of the file or folder inside that root.

prim_path.description: New absolute wrapper prim path; parent must exist.

format.description: auto (default): from the file name, or from what the folder holds. Or usd, urdf, xacro, sdf, mjcf, mesh, map to say it.

xacro_args.description: For xacro: values for its $(arg name), e.g. {"ur_type": "ur10e"}. Names the file declares are in the result.

sdf_model.description: For an SDF with several models (a Gazebo world): the model to import. Left out, a refusal lists them.

fixed_base.description: Robot formats: fix the base to the world. Default: true for URDF and xacro; the model's own setting for SDF (a static model); the file's own for MJCF. Pass false for a robot that drives or walks.

joint_targets.description: Robot formats: start in a pose. {joint name: radians, or stage units for a sliding joint}, set as drive targets; unknown names are listed in the warnings.

scale.description: Mesh files: multiply the size (the file's unit to metres, e.g. 0.001 for millimetres). Default 1: metres.

up_axis.description: Mesh files: the file's own up axis, y or z. Default auto: glTF, GLB, FBX and OBJ are Y-up, STL and PLY Z-up; the result is Z-up.

as_collider.description: Mesh files: none (default, looks only), convex_hull or convex_decomposition collision shapes.

wall_height.description: ROS map (.yaml): wall height in metres. Default 1.

mass.description: Mesh files: kilograms; makes it a dynamic rigid body (with a convex hull collider unless you pick one).

default_drives.description: Author drives that hold a pose. URDF, xacro, SDF: default true (they have none). MJCF: default false; true gives joints with no drive (torque motors) a generic holding drive. Wheels and casters stay free.

position.description: Three finite coordinates in stage units. Omit it for a robot format: the robot is then raised out of any ground plane (up to 3 m); a given position is used as is, with a warning if it starts inside the ground. USD files go to the origin.

assets.packs.description: List the asset packs in every store, the selected pack and where that choice came from. Host side, no Kit, no USD parser. Writes nothing. Kit reads its own settings: give host and Kit the same ISAAC_MCP_ASSET_PATH, or Kit will not see these packs. With a Kit connected it also lists kit_environment and warns when Kit and this host use different project files, stores or strict mode.

assets.pack_doctor.description: Check a pack without changing it: corrupt, missing and unpinned files, then the dependencies of its entry files (unresolved, unreadable, remote, outside the pack). A file accepted at build time with allow_unresolved is still missing, so it is reported and ok is false until the file is added: assets__import_path refuses it for the same reason. Unused files are information. Parses USD in a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; says so if neither ran, and ok is then false. A URDF's own references are read on the host.

pack.description: Pack name. Default: the selected pack.

entries.description: Files in the pack that are its roots. Default: recorded in the pack, or the twin's known names for ur5e-dt.

assets.dependencies.description: Compute dependency closures for files under an approved root or a user asset store. USD uses UsdUtils.ComputeAllDependencies through a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. A .urdf is read on the host with the build's package rules and returns its meshes, textures and package.xml, so a missing package is reported instead of a parser error. Copies nothing.

paths.description: Absolute USD or URDF file paths, 1 to 64.

assets.pack_adopt.description: Create a pack in the primary asset folder, or copy a folder's asset files into it and pin them. The source must be under a user-approved root; no tool can approve folders. A symlink is never followed: a named one is refused, and one met while copying a folder is listed in skipped_symlinks with a note. A different file already there is refused unless force=true; nothing is written inside the repository.

source_path.description: Absolute folder under an approved root. Omit to create an empty pack.

files.description: Copy only these files or folders, relative to source_path. A named file is copied whatever its type.

entries.description: Root USD files, relative to the pack, for assets__pack_doctor. Default: a sole top-level USD.

dry_run.description: Report the plan and write nothing.

force.description: Replace files that differ from the source.

assets.pack_pin.description: Record the current SHA-256 of a pack's files in its SHA256SUMS, in the primary asset folder. New files are pinned; a pin that would change accepts whatever bytes are there, so it is refused with before and after hashes unless the file is named in files or force=true.

force.description: Accept every changed and removed file.

assets.pack_build.description: Copy USD, URDF, MuJoCo XML, SDF, mesh or ROS map files and only what they depend on into a pack in the primary asset folder, keeping layout, and pin them. A URDF brings its meshes, textures and package.xml; an MJCF its includes and meshes; a glTF its buffers and images; a map its image. Sources must be under an approved root or a user asset store. Unresolved or remote references refuse the build unless allow_unresolved=true (then importable=false). Differing files need force=true. For xacro use assets__import_path.

pack.description: Destination pack name: one folder name.

sources.description: USD, URDF, MJCF (.xml), SDF, mesh or map (.yaml) files, 1 to 64: absolute paths, or paths inside from_pack. A USD scene outside from_pack and layout_root is read for its references and not copied.

from_pack.description: Pack that source names and logical references such as robot/ur5e.usd come from.

layout_root.description: Absolute folder the pack layout is relative to. Default: from_pack; for a USD the source's folder; for a URDF the approved root or pack holding it, which is also where its ROS packages are looked for.

origin.description: Where these files came from, one line (for example a repository URL and commit). Recorded in the pack's isaac-mcp-pack.json and listed by assets__packs, so you can see later what a pack used.

allow_unresolved.description: Build despite missing or remote references, and record them.

dry_run.description: Report the closure and write nothing.

force.description: Replace files that differ from the source.
